newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTORCYCLING-SUZUKI TURN BACK CLOCK AT LE MANS.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-SUZUKI TURN BACK CLOCK AT LE MANS.

text.p: Suzuki won the Le Mans 24-hour motorcycle race on Sunday, 12 years after their last success on the famous Bugatti circuit.
Team riders Juan-Eric Gomez of France, American Doug Polen and Australian Peter Goddard finished 10 laps ahead in the world endurance championship opener.
Suzuki took the lead just before sunset on Saturday and kept it throughout the night, completing 578 laps.
Honda were forced to retire after French rider Jean-Michel Mattioli fell and broke a wrist.
Piergiogio Bontempi of Italy recorded the fastest lap in the race, clocking one minute 45.695 seconds, but engine trouble eventually forced his Kawasaki team out with six hours to go.
